Subject: Security review kickoff & next steps — Redwood trial (FinApps)

Hi Olivia / Rajiv — thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on scope and timeline.

Call attendees:
- Olivia Grant (FinApps) — Product Manager
- Rajiv Menon (FinApps) — Head of Security
- Marissa Cole (Redwood) — AE
- Rishi Malhotra (Redwood) — Solutions Engineer (cc'd)

Key highlights / decision criteria you called out:
- Latency < 250ms p95 for critical endpoints
- Predictable unit cost for inference (monthly commit vs pay-as-you-go)
- Data residency + audit logs for regulatory audits
- SSO + SCIM for user provisioning

Scope clarifying questions for FinApps (please confirm):
1) Systems in scope: Production API + Staging test environment (please confirm names and VPCs).
2) Data classification: you indicated PII in some responses — please confirm which endpoints and any retention limits.
3) Security questionnaire: happy to receive your questionnaire to kick off evidence collection.
4) Procurement steps: who is the economic buyer / contract owner and what does your PO / SOW process look like?

Proposed next steps:
- Rajiv: send over security questionnaire and initial list of docs (SOC 2, network diagram, encryption details).
- Rishi: point person for technical evidence and integration (will gather egress IPs, cert details, and an integration plan).
- Marissa: coordinate procurement and commercial questions; request any form/vendor paperwork.
- Proposed kickoff meeting for evidence collection: Thu 2026-03-12 or Mon 2026-03-15 — please indicate best time.

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks — looping Rishi and Dev to start the technical work.

—

Marissa / Olivia — thanks, useful summary. I attached our standard security questionnaire to start (FinApps_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx). A few clarifications from our side to help scope the work: 

- Systems in scope: Production API (api.prod.finapps.com) and Staging (api.staging.finapps.com). Both run in our AWS account under VPC-PA-01.
- Data classification: Responses from the model will include user PII for some endpoints (names, emails). We'll need retention controls and the ability to purge user data on request.
- Required evidence: SOC 2 Type II report (most recent), encryption at rest and in transit details, key management (KMS/HSM), network egress IPs, TLS cert details.
- Integration: we plan to integrate via TLS HTTPS calls to your hosted API. We'll need a list of egress IPs and ISP ranges for allowlisting.
- Procurement: cc'd procurement@finapps.com on this thread. Our procurement timeline for a standard SaaS vendor is ~2–3 weeks post-Sec review + contract.

Attached: FinApps_Security_Questionnaire.xlsx

Can Rishi confirm the following by EOD tomorrow?
- SOC 2 availability and how we can access it (secure link / NDA)
- Preliminary list of egress IPs + TLS fingerprinting info

Thanks,
Rajiv Menon

Thanks — happy to own the technical evidence collection. Quick answers and plan: 

- SOC 2 Type II: Redwood has a current SOC 2 Type II. Marissa, I will upload a secure, expiring link to the report to the Drive folder and share with Rajiv and Olivia.
- Egress IPs: preliminary list (for allowlisting) — 54.243.12.45, 34.201.76.124, 3.140.18.209. I will confirm ranges and include ASN info by EOD tomorrow.
- TLS / certs: we use Let’s Encrypt for some endpoints and organizational certs for customer-facing gateways; I will include cert fingerprints in the evidence packet.
- Integration plan: for a short proof-of-concept we recommend using a dedicated API key and a staging service account; please share a test endpoint and a service account with minimal scope.
- Data flow diagram: Dev and I will produce a one-page network/data flow diagram showing what systems are in-scope (Prod, Staging, CI/CD artifact storage).

Next steps (technical):
1) I’ll upload SOC 2 link + a folder with egress IPs / certs / data-flow diagram by Thu 2026-03-12 12:00 PM PT.
2) Schedule a 30-min walkthrough with Rajiv to go through the questionnaire — Thu 10:00 AM PT works for me.

If there are any constraints around sharing the SOC2 (NDA requirements), let me know and we’ll route through secure transfer.

—

Marissa — procurement here. Quick note on process to keep timelines aligned: 

- Standard steps: Security review complete -> Legal review of Master SaaS Agreement -> PO issuance. Typical lead time: 2–3 weeks after security signoff for standard SaaS deals.
- Required vendor materials: W-9 (or equivalent tax form), supplier onboarding form (attached to our portal), and primary vendor legal contact for contract redlines.
- For expedited pilots we sometimes do a short SOW + PO instead of a full MSA; happy to discuss.

Please send vendor contact for legal (name/email) and a W-9 to procurement@finapps.com. We’ll plan for the kickoff on Thu 2026-03-12 at 10:00 AM PT unless we hear a conflict.

Thanks,
FinApps Procurement
procurement@finapps.com
